title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-12 Noether RA25 and RA26 Paper 02 symbol audit tranches
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This backfill version keeps the curated reader-facing working surface and adds the compact RA25 source-critical symbol-audit package that should accompany the already-published RA26 tranche.

Current reader files. The main cumulative readers and standalone English paper PDFs remain the reader-facing surface. RA25 and RA26 are correction/audit tranches for the German/source branch of Paper 02, not full multilingual propagation packages.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts and translation drafts; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Latest correction packages. RA25 is a source-critical mathematical symbol audit for Noether Paper 02 printed pp.71-75 and p.76 through formula (27). It restores Latin-v notation, stars/footnotes, source-visible underlines, hats, row grouping, and source-like spatial arrays through that boundary. RA26 continues the same audit from printed p.76 lower material through p.79 and p.80 top before section 23. The next target remains Paper 02 p.80 section 23 onward; table plates remain open.

Known open items. RA12-RA26 German corrections remain queued for EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH after local Paper 02 closure. Full symbol-level source audit remains open beyond Paper 01 and the current Paper 02 tranches.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Backfill public update adds N_SYM_RA25_P02_p71_76_20260612.zip. RA25 closes German/source Paper 02 pp.71-75 and p.76 through formula (27); RA26 remains the continuation through printed p.79 and p.80 top before section 23. p.80 section 23 onward, table plates, and EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH propagation remain open. Not a certified critical edition.
